changelog:
1.6.0 — Security release

  • CSV export now neutralises formula-injection characters, and import strips the guard so values round-trip losslessly.
  • Member contact details (email, phone, mobile, social links) are no longer exposed through the public REST API.
  • The vCard endpoint honours the profile-content settings: 404 when “Save contact” is disabled, contact details omitted when contact display is off. Carriage returns are stripped from vCard values.
  • The public profile endpoint is rate-limited per IP (120 requests per 5 minutes).
  • Audit confirmed: nonces and capability checks on every state-changing action, prepared SQL throughout, escaped output, validated uploads, HTTPS-only update packages.

1.5.7

  • Renamed to Emotio Team Pro; the builder element category is now “Team Pro”.
  • An H1 at the top of a member’s biography renders as a heading in the profile (demoted to H2), with proper styles for H2/H3/H4 inside the bio.

1.5.6

  • Fixed biography content staying invisible inside the profile modal and slide-out panel on Salient sites, where builder entrance animations never trigger inside an injected overlay.
